data.title: Skip-Count Safari!
data.description: Explore exciting number patterns across the whole chart by clicking the right spots.

challenges.instruction: Tap every number in the skip-counting-by-2s pattern, all the way to 100.
challenges.hint: Try looking at every other square as you move across the rows.

challenges.instruction: Tap every number in the skip-counting-by-5s pattern, all the way to 100.
challenges.hint: Watch for the columns that line up at the end of each hand count.

challenges.instruction: Tap every number in the skip-counting-by-10s pattern, all the way to 100.
challenges.hint: Check the very last column on the right side of the chart for a straight vertical path.
